S0288.reason: Microtubules and MAPs are critical for neuronal and cytoskeletal/mitotic functions; among options, cardiac contraction relies on microtubule-stabilized cytoskeletal integrity, whereas transcription, Krebs cycle, and meiosis are less directly MAP-dependent.

S0313.reason: Rho(D) immune globulin prevents RhD alloimmunization by stopping formation of maternal anti-RhD antibodies.

S1029.reason: Strict liability for wild animals covers only harms characteristic of the animal's dangerous propensity; being splashed is not the type of harm normally inflicted by a shark.
